question: Create a report for Q1 including insights and action items for Q2.
interpretation: A quarter is a calendar quarter of the current year unless the user names a year; if it is not complete yet, say so and use the last complete quarter. A good report needs several queries: KPI by month inside the quarter versus the previous quarter, category mix and returns. Structure: executive summary, KPIs, drivers, risks, actions for the next quarter with owners. Separate evidence from hypotheses. Get quarter totals (revenue, orders, buyers) from a separate query without the category breakdown; never add category rows together in prose, because orders and buyers are not additive across categories and mental sums are error-prone.
metric_definitions: completed_revenue, orders, buyers, avg_order_value per month
grain: calendar quarter vs previous quarter, monthly and category breakdown
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(oi.created_at), QUARTER) AS quarter,
  p.category AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS completed_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) AS buyers
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE oi.status = 'Complete'
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), QUARTER), INTERVAL 2 QUARTER)
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) < DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), QUARTER)
GROUP BY quarter, category
ORDER BY quarter, completed_revenue DESC
analyst_report:
Executive summary: <quarter> completed revenue <revenue> (<qoq_change> versus <previous_quarter>).
KPIs: orders <orders>, buyers <buyers>, AOV <aov>.
Drivers: <top_growing_categories> grew; <declining_categories> declined.
Risks: rising returns in <category>; dependence on <top_category>.
Actions for next quarter: 1) <action> (owner: merchandising); 2) <action> (owner: marketing); 3) <action> (owner: operations). Each action names the metric that will track it.
